headline: Strong Q2; Surging orders strengthens growth visibility

highlights: Order momentum (+85.9% YoY) was broad-based across domestic transmission, industries, data centres, exports (+41% YoY) and services (+77% YoY).
The data centre opportunity continues to gain traction across India and APAC, with the recently launched grid-to-rack solution expected to be manufactured locally upon securing orders.

Execution of the Khavda– Nagpur and Bhadla–Fatehpur HVDC projects are progressing, with ~5% and ~10% of project cumulative revenues recognised, respectively, while 4–5 new HVDC opportunities are expected over the next 12–24 months, including an approved 800kV VSC project.

Structural growth drivers remain intact across grid modernisation, renewable integration, HVDC, BESS, data centres and industrial electrification, supported by a strong pipeline and management's confidence in sustained growth in base orders.
valuation: Ongoing capacity expansion projects are largely targeted for completion by end-2027, alongside a new large power transformer facility planned for 2028.
The stock is currently trading at P/E of 54.0x/45.2x on the earnings of FY28E/29E.
The company has secured multiple orders from global hyperscalers and domestic players across India and Asia-Pacific excluding US.
watch: The company is also well-positioned for the emerging 1,150kV AC opportunity, having completed design, testing and localisation of key equipment.
Key wins included transformer and STATCOM orders, grid automation projects, data centre orders from global hyperscalers and domestic players, and service contracts.
